title: Near-Departure Cabin Reduction on Summit Top-Up Miles
content:
The Crestline Summit Loyalty Program lowers the net price per thousand of a top-up purchase for a trip that departs soon, according to the cabin requested. The trip covered is the ticket of the latest waitlisted miles upgrade request; its scheduled departure is the one the ticket's record under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter shows, and the cabin is the one that latest waitlisted miles upgrade request asks for.

**Rule.** The days are counted in calendar days from the purchase to the trip's scheduled departure.

| Trip departs | Latest waitlisted miles upgrade request asks for | Taken off per 1000 miles (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Within 21 days of the purchase | First | 1.5 |
| Within 21 days of the purchase | Premium Economy | 0.75 |
| More than 21 days after the purchase | any cabin | None |

The reduction is taken off the net price per thousand.

**Boundary readings (hypothetical).** A purchase on 1 May for a trip departing 22 May (21 days) asking for First takes 1.5 USD off per thousand; for a trip departing 23 May (22 days) nothing is taken off.
